description: This file defines the EmploymentStatus class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the report filtering context. The class extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing functionality to add filtering conditions based on employment status, retrieve entity aliases, and serialize the employment status to an array format.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: Represents a filter field for employment status in report queries, allowing addition of where conditions based on employment status, conversion to array form, and providing entity aliases.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filter condition to the query builder if the operator is EQUAL and a value X is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array containing the entity alias 'employee' used in the query.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Fetches the employment status entity by ID and returns its id and label as an array, or null if not found.
